game_title: Unit Trader – Ash Rim Trail Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of obsidian shards is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of obsidian shards is fair. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about fair_trades to power up the fire warden and open the magma valve.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
